subject: Error when using SECR with polygon detectors

messages.author: b0621462f80cbf25
messages.subject: Error when using SECR with polygon detectors
parts:
Hello, 
We have a sampling grid, from within which faecal samples have been collected and identified to individuals.  I have modelled each square in the grid as polygons and havbe a capture history file with each individual faecal samples latittude and longitude coordinates.  When I run read.capthist command I get the following error: 

Error in order(captTrap, abs(captures[validcapt, 3]), captID) : 
  argument lengths differ
In addition: Warning message:
In make.capthist(capt, trps, fmt = fmt, noccasions = noccasions,  :
  detections with coordinates outside polygon(s) were dropped

I cannot find any documentation about this first error, could some suggest the cause please?  

My capture history file is 6 columns and saved as csv with columns, Session, ID, occassion, X (as a longitude coordinate), Y (as latitude coordinate) and a covariate (sex) which is seperated by a slash, so the first row looks like 

Session1, Ind1, 1, 33.5535, 0.6784, /m

The warning suggests that some of my captures are falling outside of the polygon detectors, which they shouldnt be, I believe I have all the coordinates correctly entered, and all detections fall within a polygon

Could anyone help please.
Thanks

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error when using SECR with polygon detectors
parts:
Hi Alex
There may be several different things to tidy up. Did you project your lat lon coordinates? Once you fix that, can you plot the trps object? The format for individual covariates does not use a slash / separator. It may be inefficient to use one polygon per grid cell (depending on how many grid cells we are talking about). I suggest discretizing as many point detectors (leaving area-search behind), at least initially.
Murray
